geometryBasis: The 1912 Goad atlas plate 14 traces the whole building envelope and two open service courts. The two surviving Cypress-facing annex corners and the Peel wall axis fix the plan registration. The modern tower is a distinct building.
sectionBasis: The public-domain Wm. Notman & Son photograph establishes the Second Empire original, large corner dome, two distinct wall heights, raised mansard pavilions, front roof projection, and the rhythms of the Peel and Cypress façades.
